checks: Two horns start a scene; one horn, player blockage, moving/empty/unsafe cars do not
Driver choice depends on ID, not skin, sex or clothing; real movement, reciprocal punches and return
Only the obstruction ahead and in line of sight can trigger
No punch through walls or outside reach; witnesses react once at first punch
Nearby gunfire disperses; distant shots do not; no reactivation of wreck/player vehicle/dead driver
Fear, leg wound, theft grievance and traffic danger have priority
Police intervenes only in line of sight; no endless return when a door becomes blocked
Pedestrian disputes and road/pedestrian arguments occur without a quadratic crowd scan
At most two incidents; queues bounded; pause and interiors do not advance state
Save/resume preserves participants, timer, random damage and physical return
scope: Actual state machine with deterministic collision/movement fixture; no graphical or physical iPhone claim
